import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
PX=.22185986964255727

def smooth_path(p, spacing=.6, sigma=2.5):
 p=np.array(p,float)
 t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1))]
 ts=np.linspace(0,t[-1],int(np.ceil(t[-1]/spacing))+1)
 a=np.array([np.interp(ts,t,p[:,i]) for i in range(3)]).T
 n=int(np.ceil(4*sigma/spacing))
 a=np.vstack([a[0]-(a[1]-a[0])*np.arange(n,0,-1)[:,None],a,a[-1]+(a[-1]-a[-2])*np.arange(1,n+1)[:,None]])
 a=gaussian_filter1d(a,sigma/spacing,axis=0,mode='nearest')[n:-n]
 a[:,2]=np.maximum(0,a[:,2]);a[0,2]=a[-1,2]=0
 return a

def tip_path(p):
 a=smooth_path(p)
 tangent=np.gradient(a[:,:2],axis=0)
 tangent/=np.linalg.norm(tangent,axis=1)[:,None]
 press=(a[:,2]*PX+.3)/1.187
 press[[0,-1]]=0
 zcm=press/10
 offset=np.maximum(0,1.115-.967*(zcm-1.091)**2)*10/PX
 out=np.c_[a[:,:2]+offset[:,None]*tangent,20-press]
 return out

"""Replayable 16-stroke copy of 靜. Fit data specifies brush-root centerlines and widths in image pixels."""
import os,json,time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
from common import tip_path,PX
D=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))+'/'

def generate():
 paths=json.load(open(D+'paths.json'))
 s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
 def move(pos,speed=.07,settle=3):
  return p['move_tip'](pos,speed=speed,settle=settle)
 def world(pt):
  x,y=s.geo.px_to_world(pt[0],pt[1]);return np.array([x,y,pt[2]/1000])
 # Ink the brush, then travel above the sheet.
 move([-.1,.15,.06]);move([-.1,.15,.026],.025,10);move([-.1,.15,.055])
 for i,path in enumerate(paths):
  traj=tip_path(path)
  first=world(traj[0]);last=world(traj[-1])
  direction=traj[1,:2]-traj[0,:2];direction/=np.linalg.norm(direction)
  before=world(np.r_[traj[0,:2]-direction*12,40])
  move(before,.10,3)
  move([first[0],first[1],.027],.035,3)
  move(first,.005,5)
  # Track a smooth, slowly varying path. Interpolate in physical 3D space.
  positions=np.array([world(v) for v in traj])
  dist=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(positions,axis=0),axis=1))]
  tt=np.linspace(0,dist[-1],int(np.ceil(dist[-1]/.00025))+1)
  positions=np.array([np.interp(tt,dist,positions[:,j]) for j in range(3)]).T
  for pos in positions[1:]:
   q,ok,err=s.ik(pos)
   if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('IK',i,pos,err))
   s.step(q)
  p['hold'](8)
  move([last[0],last[1],.042],.015,5)
  print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,flush=True)
  Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(D+'canvas.png')
 actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,D+'trajectory.npz')
 np.save(D+'ink.npy',s.ink())
 import pickle
 pickle.dump(s.strokes(),open(D+'strokes.pkl','wb'))
 print('score',json.dumps(s.score()),flush=True)
 print('sha',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__': generate()
